basic_info.description: Discover unparalleled contemporary luxury in this rare, newly constructed Bernal Heights residence. Designed for modern living, the open-concept main level seamlessly blends sophistication and functionality, featuring premium Thermador stainless steel appliances and chic quartz countertops in the gourmet kitchen. Expansive NanaWall doors merge indoor elegance with a serene, landscaped garden, creating an ideal space for entertaining. Bathed in natural light, this home offers breathtaking East Bay views from multiple perspectives. A striking glass-encased floating wood staircase leads to the upper levels, enhancing the architectural allure. The versatile EV ready garage adapts to your lifestyle, whether for parking or creative use. Nestled near the vibrant Cortland shopping district, enjoy proximity to trendy cafes, top restaurants, Good Life Grocery, and daily conveniences. With freeway access nearby, commuting across San Francisco or beyond is a breeze. This meticulously crafted Bernal Heights gem delivers a unique chance to own a luxurious, contemporary haven in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods, combining style, comfort, and unbeatable connectivity.
